# PlanBOQ test data

Generated by `generate_testdata.py` (Pillow, reportlab). The same 9.6 m x 7.2 m
apartment plan is exported four ways:

| File | What it tests | Expected result in PlanBOQ |
|---|---|---|
| `sample_plan.dxf` | DXF import (R12, `$INSUNITS`=mm, layers WALLS/PARTITIONS/DOORS/WINDOWS/COLUMNS/DIM) | Project opens; 26 lines, 2 door-swing polylines, 1 circular column; layer kinds guessed (WALLS → external wall, PARTITIONS → internal wall, DOORS → door, WINDOWS → window). Scale "DXF units (mm)". **3 rooms auto-detected** (16.8 / 26.2 / 16.8 m²). BOQ: brickwork ≈ 25.68 m³, plaster ≈ 240.2 m², flooring ≈ 62.9 m², ceiling ≈ 59.9 m², opening deduction 5.22 m² (2 doors + 1 window). |
| `sample_plan.pdf` | Vector PDF import (reportlab line paths) | Page 1 geometry imports (114 segments); scale "paper mm" until calibrated. |
| `sample_plan.png` | Photo/gallery trace on a clean sheet | Confirm-page box is pre-placed by auto-detection; Trace → wall lines with text labels removed; 3–4 rooms after calibration. |
| `sample_plan_photo.png` | The same on a perspective-skewed, lit, noisy "phone photo" | **Auto-detected page box hugs the sheet** ("Page detected"); Trace removes the LIVING/KITCHEN/BATH/BEDROOM text noise and deskews the walls; calibrate with 9600 mm along the top wall → rooms appear with m² labels. |

## Push to an emulator/device

```bash
# files visible to the DXF/PDF system file picker (Downloads)
adb push sample_plan.dxf sample_plan.pdf /sdcard/Download/
# images for the photo picker
adb push sample_plan.png sample_plan_photo.png /sdcard/Pictures/
# make the new images visible to MediaStore (needed for the Android photo picker)
adb shell "content insert --uri content://media/external/images/media \
  --bind _data:s:/sdcard/Pictures/sample_plan.png --bind mime_type:s:image/png" || true
```

If the two images don't appear in the picker, open the Files app once (or
reboot the emulator) — MediaProvider indexes on access.

## Suggested test script

1. **Settings** → the server URL is pre-filled (`https://api.corecivil.engineer`).
   Paste the API key from the server `.env`, tap **Test connection** →
   expect "Server reachable · API key OK", then **Save**.
2. **New plan → DXF drawing** → pick `sample_plan.dxf` → editor opens.
   Check: layer names, ~26 lines, column circle at bottom-right, two door arcs.
3. **New plan → Vector PDF** → `sample_plan.pdf` → editor opens; tap **Scale**,
   tap two ends of the 9.6 m wall, enter `9600`, then verify with `7200`.
4. **New plan → Choose a photo or scan** → `sample_plan_photo.png` → drag the
   four corner handles onto the sheet → **Trace plan** → toast should say
   "Traced on server" (if the key is set and online).
5. Editor: select a line (tap), drag an endpoint, add a line, switch layers,
   delete a noisy line, undo.
6. **Export → Vector PDF** → share/save; open the PDF — lines should be crisp
   vector, with scale bar and the verify-before-use note.
7. Export → **DXF** → open in any CAD viewer (or re-import it into PlanBOQ).
8. **Fallback test**: turn off emulator Wi-Fi (Settings → Network) → trace
   again → toast "Server unavailable — traced on device"; app still works.
9. **Free tier**: `FreeTier` allows 3 conversions/month. In a debug build,
   Settings → "DEBUG: force Pro entitlement" bypasses the limit and the
   watermark for testing.
